headline: Lamar tops the Southland with a defense no rival matched
dek: Lamar conceded 14 goals in all its matches, fewer than any other Southland program, and lost only three times. It scored 40, well short of Northwestern State's total, and finished above it all the same.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Goals did not buy Northwestern State safety: it conceded 50, more than any other program, and its eleven wins came with ten losses.

wire.line: Southland programs scored 197 goals against non-conference opponents and conceded 169, yet lost more often than they won.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Three matches passed their dates with no result published, one each involving Southeastern Louisiana, Nicholls and Lamar.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Marissa Gross, a midfielder, scored twelve of Lamar's 40 goals.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Shannon Dempsey conceded ten goals for McNeese while making 70 saves, a save percentage of .875.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Allyson Reed scored eight of East Texas A&M's 22 goals, from 86 shots.

last_match.line: No side scored more against Lamar in a single match all season.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
